basis: Neither the rubric nor the match prompt sets a strength for a partnership pattern narrated without the disposition's label; the product answered moderate 3 of 3 against strong in the dc9dd997 run. Ruled TAILORING_ONLY/strong 2026-09-25; DIRECT/strong added on Seth's ruling 2026-11-06, since no rule decides whether a quality word on an action labels the disposition, and the case keeps its job of catching a wrong GAP.

Scale is the named difference, which the rubric says may be moderate, but owners are shown and priorities only loosely, so weak is also a reading it allows; the product answered weak 3 of 3 against moderate in the dc9dd997 run.
